issues.description: Test now passes a zero-amount/zero-puzzlehash Addition that changes semantics under test
issues.detail: Tests previously passed additions=[] to exercise the legacy single-output path via amount/inner_address. The change to additions=[Addition(amount=0, puzzle_hash=zeros)] now exercises a different code path (the additions branch) and may also trigger a real on-chain zero-value coin to a null puzzle hash. This loses coverage of the legacy fallback and risks creating burn coins.

issues.description: cat_spend forwards request.memos as list[str] into Addition.memos but loses per-addition memo encoding
issues.detail: In the legacy fallback branch, request.memos (list[str]) is placed into Addition(memos=...) directly. Previously memos were encoded utf-8 into list[bytes] before passing to generate_signed_transaction. The new flow relies on downstream conversion via Addition; verify create_signed_transaction performs the same utf-8 encoding, otherwise memos semantics regress.

issues.description: MAX_COIN_AMOUNT validation removed from cat_spend additions path
issues.detail: The previous cat_spend explicitly raised when addition.amount > MAX_COIN_AMOUNT. The refactor delegates entirely to create_signed_transaction; if that endpoint does not enforce the same bound, callers get a different/late error. Confirm equivalent validation exists downstream, otherwise this is a behavior regression for over-limit additions.

issues.description: send_transaction no longer validates address prefix via expected_prefix; uses ensure_valid_address with AddressType.XCH only
issues.detail: The old code checked the configured selected_network's address_prefix. ensure_valid_address with allowed_types={XCH} validates bech32 type but may not enforce the configured network prefix the same way. On non-mainnet (testnet) configs this could allow or reject differently than before. Verify ensure_valid_address consults self.service.config consistently.

issues.description: cat_discrepancy_validation uses 'None in {a,b,c}' which deduplicates set members
issues.detail: Using a set literal works but is semantically odd (set membership) and was carried over from the original code. A tuple/list would be clearer and avoid hashing concerns. Minor readability nit since it's now a shared helper used in two places.

issues.description: Unused local in send_transaction after refactor
issues.detail: The call to get_wallet(...) is kept only for its side-effect of raising. The comment '# opportunity to raise' helps, but assigning to _ or wrapping in a helper would make the intent more explicit and prevent a linter from flagging it as dead code later.

review.summary: The refactor sensibly consolidates send_transaction and cat_spend onto create_signed_transaction, but several behavior-preserving details need verification: address-prefix validation semantics, MAX_COIN_AMOUNT enforcement, and memo encoding now happen downstream rather than inline. The test change from additions=[] to additions=[Addition(0, zeros)] alters which code path is exercised and could create unintended zero-value outputs. The shared cat_discrepancy_validation helper is a clean dedup. Overall reasonable, but please confirm parity on the noted edge cases before merging.
